generation_notes.rvv_annotations: generate_rvv.py reads locked repaired impl/testRVV.c, injects exact public test_rvv contract plus proof/c/rvv.annotations.json. Self-ne macro retains two address operands, requires their actual local identity and owns one vector; all call operands are literally va/va or vb/vb. Same-frontend raw/CPP token identity checked. Search limit1024 and exact-cell priorities local(0) give 55 actual VC.
generation_notes.wrapper_annotations: generate_wrapper.py reads whole public spec.c, -DQCP_FORMAL, adds only proof/c/wrapper.annotations.json loop/assert comments. No C behavior changes. Actual six bodies qcp_fmax_read/preserve_float/check_observation/same_lane/compare_outputs/equivalent.
generation_notes.source_frozen: Do not run source-generating component checkers while the full owner binds these hashes; use the frozen hand proofs and regenerate actual target files in a new isolated run.
